query: TCFD 披露 TCFD 披露 衡量企业气候信息披露与TCFD四大支柱（治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标）的契合程度。 重点考察：披露完整性、可比性、可核验性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，0-4分) • 2分：四大支柱完整披露，指标/目标清晰，边界、方法、假设透明，信息可追溯。 • 1分：仅覆盖部分支柱，披露深度有限。 • 0分：无 TCFD 相关披露。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，0-4分) • 2分：披露覆盖 >80% 业务实体/合并范围。 • 1分：覆盖 20% - 50%。 • 0分：无有效覆盖信息。 最终得分 = 0.5×内容质量+0.5×覆盖应用 TCFD 气候相关财务披露 治理支柱 战略支柱 风险管理支柱 指标与目标 TCFD索引 气候信息披露对照 ISSB IFRS S2 TCFD Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures climate-related financial disclosures governance pillar strategy pillar risk management pillar metrics and targets TCFD index climate disclosure alignment ISSB IFRS S2 报告是否明确按TCFD或等价气候披露框架组织信息？ 治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标四大支柱是否均有披露？ 指标、目标、边界、方法或假设是否可追溯？ 披露覆盖了哪些业务实体或合并范围？ 是否提供TCFD索引表或支柱对照？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator 'TCFD 披露'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 报告是否明确按TCFD或等价气候披露框架组织信息？ 治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标四大支柱是否均有披露？ 指标、目标、边界、方法或假设是否可追溯？ 披露覆盖了哪些业务实体或合并范围？ 是否提供TCFD索引表或支柱对照？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅单点披露物理风险或转型风险而无框架映射；仅有减排目标而无治理/战略/风险管理支柱；仅提及“参考TCFD”而无实质内容；仅有场景分析而无整体支柱覆盖；区分：TCFD披露评估四大支柱整体契合与可核验性；物理/转型风险与场景分析分别是支柱下的专题内容，单独专题充分不等于TCFD整体披露充分。注意：原关键词曾误用转型风险词表，已按TCFD框架重写。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: 2021 ENVIRONMENTAL, SOCIAL AND GOVERNANCE REPORT / SUSTAINABILITY GOVERNANCE
results.text: The Group has established an ESG framework to promote and implement the Group's sustainability strategy. To ensure effective ESG management, our ESG governance structure, composed of the Board, ESG working group, respective functional departments and subordinate companies, was established to promote ESG management and disclosure. The Board, the ultimate decision-making body of the Group, is responsible for the Group's ESG governance. The Board steers the Group's sustainable development forward and bears the overall responsibility of its ESG efforts. In the future, the Board will continue to strengthen ESG risk management and improve ESG working mechanism and regulatory processes to enhance its ESG governance standard. The ESG working group, serving on the supervision and coordination level, is responsible for implementing ESG governance strategy, coordinating ESG matters, compiling ESG reports, and reporting relevant work progress to the Board on a regular basis. Each functional department and subordinate company, serving on the execution level, is responsible for rolling out initiatives set up by the ESG working group and reporting relevant work progress and data.

The Group has established an ESG framework to promote and implement the Group's sustainability strategy. To ensure effective ESG management, our ESG governance structure, composed of the Board, ESG working group, respective functional departments and subordinate companies, was established to promote ESG management and disclosure. The Board, the ultimate decision-making body of the Group, is responsible for the Group's ESG governance. The Board steers the Group's sustainable development forward and bears the overall responsibility of its ESG efforts. In the future, the Board will continue to strengthen ESG risk management and improve ESG working mechanism and regulatory processes to enhance its ESG governance standard. The ESG working group, serving on the supervision and coordination level, is responsible for implementing ESG governance strategy, coordinating ESG matters, compiling ESG reports, and reporting relevant work progress to the Board on a regular basis. Each functional department and subordinate company, serving on the execution level, is responsible for rolling out initiatives set up by the ESG working group and reporting relevant work progress and data.

[Content]
To ensure operation efficiency and employees' development in a fair and honest working environment, the Group has formulated whistleblowing policy to promote business ethics and integrity so as to avoid suspected corruption, extortion and money laundering. Anonymous channels of reporting such as by letter, meeting or phone call for employees to report suspected corruption are provided. If there are any suspected case of corruption or related practices, employees are encouraged to report the related cases through the mentioned channels. All these practical actions not only enabled us to win over the trust of our customers, but also enhance the sense of belonging and fair play among our employees.

results.section: 2021 ENVIRONMENTAL, SOCIAL AND GOVERNANCE REPORT / A. ENVIRONMENTAL ASPECTS
results.text: The Group's businesses are mostly carried out locally in offices. The Group has encompassed the general approach towards controlling environmental impacts of office activities. The Group's most significant environmental impacts are greenhouse gas (' GHG ') emissions from electricity consumption, the sources of which mainly include computer equipment, the air-conditioning systems and the lighting systems. Generally, the Group's GHG emission mainly includes carbon dioxide (' CO 2 ').
